stories.title: Bandstand square planned for Buckley car park as town centre survey closes Sunday
stories.summary: Plans for a new square with a bandstand on part of Brunswick Road car park are among the Buckley town centre designs people have until Sunday 22 November to comment on. stories.title: Ewloe-based MoneySuperMarket warns of Winter Fuel Payment text scams
stories.summary: Pensioners are being warned about fake Winter Fuel Payment texts trying to steal their bank details as the real payments are paid out. stories.title: Government drops planned Connah’s Quay power station from HyNet carbon capture talks
stories.summary: The UK Government has dropped plans for a new carbon capture power station at Connah’s Quay from its talks on HyNet. The decision relates to the planned new power station, not the existing Connah’s Quay Power Station on Kelsterton Road. stories.summary: Hughes Pharmacy at Daniel Owen Shopping Centre in Mold is moving into a bigger shop in the centre on Monday 23 November. stories.title: Connah’s Quay wrestler Drew Parker to appear at Deeside Leisure Centre
stories.summary: The former Big Japan Pro Wrestling star has joined the National Wrestling League, which holds its first Welsh show in Queensferry on Friday 27 November.
